items.html: And we find that the main part revealed of this drop is the Yud-Hey-Vav of the Heys, which is 42, as mentioned, and within it the other two names Yud-Hey-Vav are clothed. Therefore this is the secret of the Mayin Duchrin [male waters] that go out from the palate, which is the Yesod of the Hochma of Arich Anpin, to the female, the throat of Arich Anpin, who is the Malchut of Hochma, and she is the Bina of the whole Partzuf of Arich Anpin. And these are the 42 couplings mentioned at the beginning of the introduction to the Book of Genesis; see there.
